verdict.rationale: Capsule's own docs describe two lightweight background behaviors: Tracks, a series of tasks that each become active one after the other, and tasks that repeat daily, weekly or monthly. Both are thin, task-only automation with no documented triggers, conditions or actions. Zapier and the API are third-party or developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native workflow/automation engine with triggers and actions, autonomous record updates or emails, AI or agentic execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Tracks to set up a series of tasks that each become active one after the other.
Set a task to repeating daily, weekly or monthly.
